text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after finishing her debut 
race, we ran mock races to bolster her 
experience running in large packs, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... ...Third place, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when she seemed to take first place, 
she'd place sixth. But then she'd win 
first place again, continuing an 
inconsistent streak of results.
choice_data_list:
(Stress is bound to build up in a state 
like this...)

(Stress is bound to build up in a state 
like this, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, there were also challenges for 
her that became apparent through this mock 
race. Those challenges being—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Whenever a competitor challenges her 
neck-and-neck, no matter the timing, she 
will duel them relentlessly until they 
back down.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as a result, in a race against 
multiple opponents...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ! Like I'll let you pass!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Unable to run at Narita Brian's true, 
natural pace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...
choice_data_list: (I want to help her somehow, but...)
(I want to do something for her, but...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey!
choice_data_list: Yes!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're Brian's Trainer, right? Has she 
been feeling under the weather lately?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez, don't get all cocky just because you 
made your debut.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Where'd all that ridiculous strength from 
our one-on-one go? There's not a trace of 
it here.
choice_data_list:
In a one-on-one, Brian is the strongest, 
you know.

In a one-on-one, Brian is the strongest, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I have to admit that's true. I got 
completely crushed the other day, too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~~, jeez! Don't go reminding me of 
the one-on-ones I lost!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Get Brian back in top shape already! 
Taking down an unbeatable Brian is what 
makes Big Sister Hishi Ama who she is, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
For all the holding back I'm doing now, 
I'm gonna let loose and take the win when 
race time comes!
choice_data_list:
(I've held back enough—time to let it all 
rip...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Do you want to win?
Do you want to win?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Well, obviously. What kind of horse 
girl goes out of her way to lose?
choice_data_list: Then why not try changing how you race?
Then why not try changing how you race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, even if challenged 
mid-race, I should hold back instead of 
contesting it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Are you telling me to turn tail and run 
from the battle right in front of me?
choice_data_list: That's not what I meant!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Then what does that mean?
choice_data_list:
It's not about holding back or running 
away, you just bottle it all up.

It's not about holding back or running 
away, it's about bottling it all up 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Bottling it up?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of her problems stemmed from the 
fierce fighting spirit she harbored within 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then bottle up that fighting spirit, turn 
it into power, and let it explode all at 
once."
choice_data_list:
I know you can achieve a "running style 
made just for you".

You should be able to find a way of 
running that's “just for you”

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...A running style that belongs entirely 
to me.
choice_data_list:
The first one to cross the finish line 
wins the race.

Whoever crosses the finish line first wins 
the race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Explain in more detail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, seven Umamusume stepped 
forward to participate in the mock race we 
organized.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
With how Brian-san is right now, I feel 
like even I could win...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I'm definitely, definitely not 
gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Bottle it up, then let it burst"... was 
it?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What about the timing?
choice_data_list: I'll leave it to you.
I'll leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her competitive instincts are 
extraordinary, allowing her to unleash her 
full potential in one-on-one duels.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without saying another word, Narita Brian 
headed toward the gate. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KER-CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: 1st place is gonna be mine--!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wha—I'm not giving an inch! Ehehe, after 
you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment the gates open, two Umamusume 
furiously vie for the lead. Narita Brian, 
meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Excuse me, mind if I join you? Allow me 
to observe as well."
choice_data_list: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh. You seem far more at ease compared to 
before. Did you find some new method to 
solve the problem, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Still, the frontrunners are really going 
at it up there~. If that's the case, 
Narita Brian might just take up the 
challenge too...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's not moving?! Brian is still back in 
the pack! She's still holding back!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hoh, that's rare. For her not to contest 
the lead herself...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit... this is so agonizing, so 
frustrating. I want to run in front...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Irritating, utterly irritating! To be 
challenged and unable to give chase, when 
my prey is right before my eyes!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Aagh, I need to catch up to her back 
right now...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...So this is what it means to hold back. 
She's asking me to do something utterly 
ridiculous...!"

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're approaching the fourth corner 
soon. And the leader remains unchanged... 
it seems.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
There was a bit of a sluggish stretch, but 
that settles it. It seems the rumors of 
Brian's slump are true.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No. That doesn't add up. Her passion 
hasn't died out—in fact, even now...
choice_data_list: (Right, this isn't the end.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian was waiting. For her own 
perfect timing, for what she believed to 
be the ultimate moment to make her move.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And once we pass the 4th corner—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(Bringing them down takes but an instant. 
Once the cage is unlocked, all that's left 
is to tear away victory's head.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I have waited so long for this.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ? Was that just now...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-What is this?! Narita Brian is bursting 
into the lead with unbelievable 
momentum...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
She's fast! How can she accelerate like 
that?! No one can possibly keep up with 
her!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
! ...Such sharpness. This is how she runs 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, you can't describe this merely as 
'running'! This is nothing short of... a 
'hunt'...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Narita Brian surged like an arrow loosed 
from a bow. No, like a bird of prey 
hunting down its quarry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no heed to the spellbound crowd, 
she plunged across the finish line all by 
herself...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: So this was how you ran all along, huh.
So this is how you ran all along, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ......Heh, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. I've never felt a 
sensation like this in my entire life.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Why did you introduce me to such a 
thing?! Now I'm completely hooked...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing no signs of post-race exhaustion, 
Narita Brian burned with a radiant fire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I felt like we had taken another 
step forward on the path we walked 
together.
